Hi care team,
Thanks for a hardworking cycle; the departures lead discussed a concern about handler pairs

I want to share a calm reminder that our pet-travel handoffs work best when we slow down, check the basics, and keep one another in the loop. <<FACT F002>> Please make sure each pet record is reviewed with care, especially when a traveler has a tight connection or a pet needs a little extra reassurance.

We also had a few questions come up around space, so please keep an eye on the lounge flow and flag anything that could affect comfort or safety. <<FACT F008>> If a case feels unclear, reach out early so we can sort it out together instead of letting small issues build up.

Thanks for the steady work you all put in for Aurelia Skyways. Small, careful actions make a big difference for every animal and every traveler.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
